data.description:
## Sunset ticket for the `lock maintenance.lock` mechanism marker

The fix for bug `saccharine-unwise-barnacle` makes the explicit store maintenance step (`event_commit_git.run_auto_maintenance`) remove `<common-dir>/objects/maintenance.lock` when the lock is older than 12 hours. That code is the `# mechanism-ok: lock maintenance.lock` marker in `src/rebar/_store/event_commit_git.py`, and this ticket is its sunset.

It exists because git never expires that lock. `builtin/gc.c` `maintenance_run_tasks` returns 0 without doing any work when it cannot take the lock, and unlike `gc.pid` it has no staleness rule.

## When to act

Do this when either condition holds:
- Upstream git expires a stale maintenance lock itself, and every rebar runtime (the MCP container image and the supported local git floor) ships that version.
- Store maintenance moves out of the post-write step, for example to a scheduled job that owns its own lock recovery.

## Plan

Delete `_reclaim_stale_maintenance_lock` and its call, the `_MAINTENANCE_LOCK_STALE_S` constant, the marker, and `tests/unit/test_store_maintenance_lock_reclaim.py`. Then run `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --update-stale`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `src/rebar/_store/event_commit_git.py` no longer removes `objects/maintenance.lock`, and no `mechanism-ok` marker names this ticket.
- [ ] `python scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py --check` exits 0.
data.title: Retire rebar's stale maintenance.lock reclaim once git expires that lock itself
